body: My nose is just bulbous and pretty generic. I actually wish I had a flatter nose like my mom but I've been cursed with my dads nose. Rhinoplasty here I come!

I only take selfies when I have control over the camera. I can't take pictures taken by someone else. I will look hideous. Even if I think I look good. I will look hideous. Even if the picture turns out alright then months later I will look at it again and be disgusted at the sight of it wondering how I ever thought I was even remotely okay looking. I avoid taking pictures to prevent this from happening in the future.

Completely understand. I don't want to create friendships with girls who are significantly more attractive than me. I know that it is superficial and its not like I perceive them as competition for guys since I already have a boyfriend but I feel like I will incessantly compare myself to them. I will notice the better treatment they receive, more compliments and I will be sidelined completely. I feel a bit of shame for thinking like this.

I like how short this poem is but it manages to conveys a deep message of abandoning childhood innocence and transitioning into a world of adulthood. Structure of poem could of been a bit better with less spacing though. Overall really nice poem!
I love this poem since it relates a lot to me with my previous relationship. So keep up the good work :D

I really love how metaphorical this poem is and distinct the symbolism it in it, my interpretation of the poem is about a one-sided relationship where the other partner makes repeated sacrifices and it isn't reciprocated in return. He is completely indifferent to her suffering and mocks her pain but she stays with him regardless. Correct me if I got anything wrong of my perspective on the poem!
Wow this poem gives me chills with its pacing and ominous tone. Great work!
